title: Jamaican Cheese Grill Skillet
description: A hearty and indulgent Jamaican-inspired dish featuring grilled cheese, onions, and bell peppers in a flavorful skillet.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sliced onions and cook until they start to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add sliced bell peppers and cook until they're tender, about 5 minutes.
Add grill cheese slices and cook until they're melted and golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Sprinkle Jamaican spice blend over the top of the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
